test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A & B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’,

‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the son of B’,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

If ‘B – A ÷ R + S & M’, then how is B related to S?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png]

 Meaning

Given: B – A ÷ R + S & M

It means: B is the son of A, A is the husband of R, R is the mother of S and S is the wife of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e601bf00a5d626e3ac70b23f45592ff60d944c214cca2064ed5c900701a2dd4.png] 

So, B is the 'Brother' of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
